notes: v1.1.113: Login no longer opens a second Chrome. The hidden captcha / relogin step now runs inside the app's own emu2 browser, off-screen, and closes itself when done; if emu2 can't start it quietly falls back as before. Because of this the big bundled browser (about 447 MB) is gone from the update, and any leftover browser folder from 1.1.110-1.1.112 is cleaned off the PC automatically. Two-factor login now works in any language: the 6-8 digit code page is recognised by its shape (e.g. Bengali), and when there is no English Continue button it submits with Enter. A stalled 'too much time passed' login flow restarts cleanly instead of hanging. Function > 956 Check: each account's Status Detail now shows every step live (opening browser, unlock, captcha, done), and it opens as many browser windows at once as the Treat setting (e.g. 4 at a time for 24 accounts) instead of one at a time. Carries 1.1.112 (restart login on FB's 'Invalid request' dialog, instant Disabled detection), 1.1.111, 1.1.110 (device-cookie login, Warm Up picker filters), 1.1.109, 1.1.108, 1.1.107 and 1.1.106.
